texts.preamble: Rajendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 July, 2018 Cr.R. No.3081/2018 1 Rajendra S/o Babulal vs. State of M.P. The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Indore : 18/07/2018 :- Shri Ashish Jaiswal, learned counsel for the petitioner. Shri Hemant Sharma, learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has held guilty in contravention of Rule 32-E of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 which has been declared ultra virus by Hon'ble the Supreme Court of India in Dwarka Nath and another vs. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi reported in 1972 FAC 1 (SC), NCT of Delhi vs. Mohinder Singh reported in 2016 (1) FAC 40 and Naresh Narubha Rathod vs. State of Gujarat and another reported in 2017 (2) FAC 464. Madhya Pradesh High Court has also followed the same field in Hariram vs. State of M.P. 2004 Rajendra S/o Babulal vs. State of M.P. (3) MPWN 23 and Ravindra Singh and another vs. State of M.P. and another reported in 2007 FAJ 455. Second contention of the petitioner is that the incident took place on 29/07/2011, while the Old Act was repealed by the New Act on 29/07/2010, therefore, his prosecution under repealed Act is bad in law.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has held guilty in contravention of Rule 32-E of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 which has been declared ultra virus by Hon'ble the Supreme Court of India in Dwarka Nath and another vs. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi reported in 1972 FAC 1 (SC), NCT of Delhi vs. Mohinder Singh reported in 2016 (1) FAC 40 and Naresh Narubha Rathod vs. State of Gujarat and another reported in 2017 (2) FAC 464. Madhya Pradesh High Court has also followed the same field in Hariram vs. State of M.P. 2004 Rajendra S/o Babulal vs. State of M.P. (3) MPWN 23 and Ravindra Singh and another vs. State of M.P. and another reported in 2007 FAJ 455. Second contention of the petitioner is that the incident took place on 29/07/2011, while the Old Act was repealed by the New Act on 29/07/2010, therefore, his prosecution under repealed Act is bad in law.
